editorial.meta_description: The SAFe Scrum Master (SSM) exam was retired on 2025-06-30. Please prepare for the successor exam, SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), to continue your professional
editorial.overview: The SAFe Scrum Master (SSM) certification, provided by Scaled Agile, covered Scrum and SAFe team practices. This exam is retired as of 2025-06-30. The direct successor is SAFe Scrum Master (SSM). Candidates should focus their efforts on the current SAFe Scrum Master (SSM) certification path to demonstrate their ability to facilitate team events and support Agile Release Trains in delivering value within a SAFe enterprise. This certification path ensures that practitioners remain aligned with the latest framework updates and organizational requirements for effective team leadership.
editorial.who_should_take: This certification is intended for individuals acting as Scrum Masters or Team Coaches within an Agile team. It is suitable for those responsible for facilitating team events, coaching team members, and supporting the delivery of value through SAFe principles and practices.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Focus your preparation on the successor SAFe Scrum Master (SSM). Concepts regarding Scrum frameworks, team coaching, and PI Planning remain relevant. Study the responsibilities of a servant leader and how to facilitate team events. Use official Scaled Agile resources to master the current requirements for the SAFe Scrum Master (SSM) certification, as the retired exam is no longer available for registration or completion. Ensure you understand the core principles of the framework to succeed in your professional role.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers the integration of Scrum into a SAFe enterprise environment, focusing on basic Agile and Scrum concepts to ensure that all team members understand the fundamental principles required for successful project delivery and collaboration.

This domain defines the specific characteristics and responsibilities of the Scrum Master and Team Coach role, emphasizing the servant leadership qualities necessary to guide teams effectively through complex development cycles and organizational changes within the SAFe framework.

This domain focuses on the facilitation of team-level events and the management of the team backlog, ensuring that all ceremonies are conducted efficiently to maintain momentum and clarity for the team throughout the entire development iteration process.

This domain addresses the Scrum Master's role in supporting events at the Agile Release Train level, including the PI Planning and Inspect and Adapt events that align teams toward common enterprise goals and continuous improvement objectives.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: The retired exam is no longer available. For the successor SAFe Scrum Master (SSM), the exam is a linear, online format included with training. Ensure you are prepared for 45 multiple-choice questions within the 90-minute time limit to achieve your certification goal.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam consists of 45 multiple-choice questions that test your knowledge of the SAFe framework, team facilitation, and the specific responsibilities associated with the Scrum Master role in an enterprise environment.

The passing score for the certification exam is 77 percent, which requires a solid understanding of the core concepts and practical applications of the SAFe methodology as defined in the official documentation.

The exam duration is 90 minutes, providing candidates with sufficient time to carefully read and answer all 45 questions while demonstrating their proficiency in Agile and Scrum practices within the SAFe enterprise.

The exam price is 995 dollars, which includes the necessary training and access to the certification materials required to prepare for and complete the assessment successfully as part of the official program.

methodology.summary: This page was built using official Scaled Agile documentation, exam guides, and certification landing pages to provide accurate information regarding the retired status and successor path for all candidates seeking professional certification.
